Rahul Gandhi to March to Supreme Court Over Election Commissioner Appointment

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi announced a march to the Supreme Court, stating that the entire country will march today against alleged 'vote theft'. This protest is directed against the appointment of Gyanesh Kumar as an Election Commissioner. Gandhi claimed the government is protecting Kumar and that they will file a petition. The 'Delhi Chalo' program was the venue for this announcement, where Gandhi attacked the central government.
